name: Brise Soleil
description: A concrete egg-crate sunscreen over panels painted in mid-century colors, the fins casting an L of shadow that deepens and thins across the facade.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8%; background: @p(var(--color1)); opacity: .45; -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / 100% @rn(2%, 62%) no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / @rn(2%, 56%) 100% no-repeat; mask: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / 100% @rn(2%, 62%) no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / @rn(2%, 56%) 100% no-repeat; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color6); -webkit-mask: @var(--bf); mask: @var(--bf); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --bf: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
